purpose: foundation-validation.yml trigger path filter dependency basis

paths.data/foundation/**: canonical registries generated/checked by migrate_legacy; include project-state.json + adjudications + proofs + validations + schemas

paths.data/foundation-architecture/**: architecture canonical outputs consumed by foundation scripts

paths.views/**: compatibility views emitted by migrate_legacy (legacy-functions/cases.jsonl, manifest.json)

paths.schemas/foundation/**: JSON schemas emitted/validated by migrate_legacy + validate_foundation

note: paths chosen from actual migration inputs/outputs of migrate_legacy.py + validate_foundation.py; no foundation real dependency omitted
